body:
Cortex repeatedly scans the map and checks distances to every building while choosing placement candidates. Resource hiring also clears and scans a fixed array even when few units qualify. This change reduces that work while preserving the same decisions and simulation state.

Three independently screened changes:

- Precompute the exact region accepted by Cortex’s existing building-distance rule, preserving candidate scan order and scoring. The mask lives only for that placement search.
- Traverse Cortex’s boolean fruit/algae presence queries in map storage order.
- Pack accepted resource-fetch candidates in unit-index order, preserving every eligibility call, failure tally and destination-purpose side effect.

**Builds on merged PR #393.** All improvements below are additional to that PR; its Maxima coordinate change is not repeated in this diff. No gradient/pathfinding implementation, AI policy, save fields or version gates change.

### Final measurements

Baseline `ef1f90ed1` → final `b8b328771`, release GCC 15.2 on therig (Threadripper 2950X), default one gradient worker/eight-tick delay, pinned to two physical cores. Medians of three runs per variant after a discarded warmup, alternating pair order. The runner waits for compiler activity to finish and retries detected overlapping samples. Simulation timing excludes startup/save loading.

| Workload | Ticks | Simulation before → after | Reduction | Whole-process reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 12 mixed AIs, 512×512 | 1,000 | 7.970 → 6.992 s | 12.3% | 5.8% |
| 8 Castor/Numbi, 256×256 | 10,000 | 9.045 → 8.502 s | 6.0% | 5.1% |
| Late Maxima/Cortex, 2,376 units, 512×256 | 1,000 | 25.384 → 23.283 s | 8.3% | 5.5% |
| 12 Cortex, islands, 512×256 | 1,000 | 12.292 → 10.009 s | 18.6% | 12.8% |
| 12 Cortex, continents, 512×256 | 1,000 | 8.055 → 7.021 s | 12.8% | 9.0% |

[Sample ranges, CPU times and every raw measurement](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/b5a39374b0794519acc0326442c0ea012368fda5/performance.md). These are workload-specific results from small samples, not a confidence interval or universal speedup.

### Validation

- All 14 starting states match for 512 consecutive per-tick checksums and recorded AI orders: baseline/candidate on macOS ARM64 and both Linux machines (84 runs). Includes the version-115 save and two fresh 12-Cortex games grown to tick 20,000.
- Geometry oracle: 184,704 comparisons including wrap, oversized bounds and empty/dead/null-type buildings. Fetch-apportionment (including sparse units through the final slot) and hiring-bucket regressions pass on Linux and macOS.
- Six pairs of checkpoint reloads match for 128 ticks. Five match uninterrupted execution; mixed continents reproduces the pre-existing tick-12,171 mismatch in both versions.
- No gameplay/AI-policy change is intended. Windows and interactive play were not tested.

[Reproducible input saves/seeds, scripts, checksums/orders, logs, profiles and source/binary hashes](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/b5a39374b0794519acc0326442c0ea012368fda5) are on a separate evidence branch. No experimental instrumentation or generated artifacts are in the production diff.

### Profiling scope

Five post-load 2,000-tick profiles with caller stacks identified Cortex placement/geometry, resource-presence scans and hiring-array overhead. Reachability/flood-fill and gradient work was excluded. Independent screening variants and the scan-order counter investigation are retained in the evidence; some preliminary screening overlapped another build, so the table above uses a fresh guarded run of the final combined version.

### Merge preparation

Rebased onto master after #393 was squash-merged. `git range-diff` confirms all three optimization patches are unchanged; measured commit `b8b328771` remains the performance reference. The new base also includes the separately merged ARM gradient optimization (#395), which was not included in these measurements. Final PR head is `3e43b1f52`.

At merge preparation, hosted CI was still running. The deployment asset test also fails on the original master baseline because its isolated job does not obtain the browser assets; this is unrelated to these optimization changes. The completed cross-platform local validation is documented above.
title: Speed up Cortex placement and building resource hiring
